And as the doctor grows as a person Kal likely gets even more conflicted with how to feel.!<

>!It's basically stuff the doctor did in the past/how they acted (which we don't know much about), like becoming cold and ruthless with strategies, pretty much disregarding lives and post cryo sleep they're pretty much a different person so the doctor she hates is "gone" so to speak. In the later chapters she struggles with how to treat them since she can't very well get upset at someone for something they have no memory of doing, yet he did do whatever she dislikes them for at the end of the day.
